description: Genie Ontology SDK — automated standup of metric views, UC Pages, and Genie Agents from Unity Catalog source assets and supplemental business context.

waves.name: Initialization
gate: Feature branch exists and is checked out
All input catalogs/schemas/tables are accessible
Repo folder structure is scaffolded
sdk_config.json is written with all input parameters

sessions.title: Input Validation & Repo Scaffolding
sessions.scope: Validate all SDK inputs, create feature branch, scaffold folder structure, write sdk_config.json.

waves.name: Domain Research
gate: docs/research/ contains at least 3 research documents
docs/semantics/ contains glossary candidates
docs/research/05_domain_subdomain_proposal.md exists

sessions.title: Domain Research — Industry & Terminology
sessions.scope: Web search for domain terminology, KPIs, industry trends, regulatory context. Write research docs and glossary candidates.

waves.name: Supplemental Context Extraction
gate: docs/context/ contains extracted context from all supplemental sources
docs/semantics/ updated with additional glossary candidates from business materials

sessions.title: Supplemental Context Parser
sessions.scope: Read supplemental volume directories and dashboard inputs. Extract business rules, KPI definitions, join criteria. Write context docs and additional glossary candidates.

waves.name: Deep Exploratory Data Analysis
gate: docs/data_profiles/ contains one profile per source table
docs/data_profiles/data_model_summary.md exists with cross-table analysis
Join key candidates are identified with cardinality verification

sessions.title: Deep EDA — Table Profiling & Relationship Detection
sessions.scope: Profile every source table: structure, integrity, quality, lineage, usage, grain, keys, cardinality, volume. Detect cross-table relationships. Write data profiles.

waves.name: Metric View Synthesis
gate: ontology-metric-views/metric_views/ contains at least one YAML per identified domain
ontology-metric-views/metric_views/manifest.json exists and is valid JSON array
Every YAML has parameterized source references (no hardcoded catalogs)
Every join has rely annotation matching Wave 3 cardinality verification
Materialization blocks present on MVs meeting threshold criteria

sessions.title: Metric View YAML Synthesis
sessions.scope: Synthesize all context (research + supplemental + EDA) into parameterized metric view YAMLs. Generate manifest.json. Include materialization blocks where appropriate.

waves.name: Metric View Registration
gate: All metric views registered in target_catalog.target_schema
Smoke test passes: every MV queryable with MEASURE() syntax
Join cardinality tests pass

sessions.title: Metric View Registration & Smoke Tests
sessions.scope: Execute CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW WITH METRICS for each metric view YAML. Run smoke tests and cardinality tests.

waves.name: UC Pages Registration
gate: UC Pages registered for all glossary candidates
Pages associated with appropriate domain/subdomain

sessions.title: UC Pages Registration
sessions.scope: Register UC Pages from docs/semantics/ glossary candidates via the Pages API. Associate with domains/subdomains.

waves.name: Genie Agent Curation
gate: ontology-genie-agents/agents/ contains at least one .geniespace.json
Agent organization follows 50 MV threshold rule
Each agent references only registered metric views
docs/domain_manifest.yml exists with proposed domain structure

sessions.title: Genie Agent Curation & Configuration
sessions.scope: Determine agent organization (single vs split by subdomain). Generate .geniespace.json for each agent. Generate domain manifest.

waves.name: Genie Agent Deployment
gate: All Genie Agents deployed and accessible
Each agent responds to at least one sample question

sessions.title: Genie Agent Deployment & Validation
sessions.scope: Deploy DAB 2 with generated .geniespace.json files. Validate each agent is accessible and responds to sample questions.

waves.name: Tuning
gate: docs/tuning/tuning_plan.md exists
docs/tuning/benchmark_results.md exists with accuracy scores
Benchmark accuracy >= 70% across all agents

sessions.title: Tuning Plan & Benchmark Execution
sessions.scope: Generate tuning plan. Run benchmark questions. Iterate on MV definitions (not agent instructions) for failures. Update YAMLs and re-register as needed.
